title: Health Check Overdue — No formal assessment in 47 days
rootCause: The last structured Health Check (T14) was completed 47 days ago. Per BMW IAM framework, active dealers require assessment every 30 days to maintain a traceable governance trail. Without a current scored baseline it is not possible to identify which audit dimension — commercial readiness, digital readiness, service maturity, or process adherence — requires targeted intervention.
impact: Governance risk — NSC cannot approve performance without current assessment on file

title: IR Response Time — Order fulfilment and query resolution not consistently meeting IR expectations
rootCause: IRs choose suppliers based on speed, convenience, and reliability. Feedback from the last visit indicates Bavaria Motors is not consistently meeting IR expectations on order turnaround times. Manual processes and phone-based ordering create delays that digital channels would eliminate. Without structured data on response times the dealer cannot identify where in the process the delay occurs.
impact: IR retention risk — slow or inconsistent response pushes IRs toward alternative suppliers offering faster digital ordering

title: PL24 Adoption at 79% — 1pt below minimum threshold
rootCause: One staff member (Braun) not consistently processing orders through PL24. Behavioural issue rather than a system or credential problem. Faster PL24 adoption would also directly improve IR response times by removing manual processing steps.
impact: +€2067/month if Braun reaches regional average PL24 usage
